comment.body:
One caveat of this approach: It is not clear, whether the user did not specify the `--container-daemon-socket` option, or they explicitly specified `--container-daemon-socket /var/run/docker.sock`. In both cases, we check whether the socket is available and set the argument to '-'.

If now, for example, a user specifies `--container-daemon-socket /var/run/docker.sock` but runs the command as non-root and is not in the docker group, the program will silently (modulo the log) replace the option with '-' and searches for another socket.
